body.value: If a player doesn't play/is ruled out, your combo isn't canceled. rules_markdown.name: rules_markdown
rules_markdown.value:
# Official contest rules

## PRIZE POOL MECHANICS

The total prize pool is $1,000,000 USD, split equally among all users who correctly predict the World Cup champion. Winnings are deposited directly to your Kalshi account after the final is resolved. Each eligible user may submit one prediction, which is final and cannot be changed after confirmation. If the tournament is canceled or has no official winner, all entries are voided.

## ELIGIBILITY

Entrants must be 18 years of age or older at time of entry, a verified Kalshi user with completed KYC verification, and a legal resident of and physically present in the United States. Residents of New York and Florida are not eligible to participate. Kalshi employees and their immediate family members are not eligible.

## TICKETS DRAWING

Every eligible entry is automatically entered into a drawing for two tickets to the World Cup Final, regardless of country selected. The drawing takes place after the Group Stage concludes and the prize is non-transferable with no cash value. The winner is responsible for all travel and accommodation expenses.

## ENTRY WINDOWS

Entries open one week before the first match of the World Cup and close at the exact moment the first game begins. Late entries will not be accepted under any circumstances. Kalshi reserves the right to disqualify entries that violate contest rules, and all decisions made by Kalshi regarding this contest are final.

###### Eligibility requirements apply. Participants must be 18 years of age or older. Contest not available outside the United States, in New York, or in Florida. Prize winners responsible for applicable taxes. Kalshi will reimburse winner(s)'s eligible purchase(s) of up to two (2) tickets to the FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final, up to a maximum of $35,000. Kalshi and this Contest are not sponsored, affiliated with, or endorsed by FIFA or the World Cup. Other terms, conditions, and restrictions apply; see [kalshi.com](https://kalshi.com/docs/pick-your-country/OFFICIAL_RULES.pdf) for full rules.
